source_text_en: Shang Han Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage)
category_zh: 解表劑－辛溫解表 / 調和營衛
category_en: Formulas that Release the Exterior - Warm, Acrid & Harmonize Ying and Wei

glance.plain_summary_zh: 《傷寒論》第一方。外感風寒表虛證之首選方——頭痛、發熱、惡風、汗出。調和營衛、解肌發表。
glance.plain_summary_en: The premier formula of Shang Han Lun. Primary formula for Wind-Cold exterior deficiency with sweating, fever, aversion to wind, and stiff neck.

composition.role_reason_zh: 辛溫解肌發表、溫通衛陽——透達表邪
composition.role_reason_en: Acrid and warm to release muscle layer and warm Wei yang - driving out exterior pathogens

composition.role_reason_zh: 酸苦微寒、酸甘化陰、和營斂陰——與桂枝相須為用，一發一斂、調和營衛
composition.role_reason_en: Sour, bitter, slightly cold; restrains ying and nourishes blood - pairs 1:1 with Gui Zhi to balance sweating and astringence

composition.role_reason_zh: 辛溫解表、溫胃止嘔——助桂枝解肌，兼和胃氣
composition.role_reason_en: Assists Gui Zhi in releasing exterior, warms Stomach to stop nausea

composition.role_reason_zh: 甘溫益氣、補脾養血——助白芍和營，兼補中州
composition.role_reason_en: Sweet and warm to tonify qi and blood - assists Bai Shao in nourishing ying and middle burner

composition.role_reason_zh: 甘溫調和諸藥——合桂枝辛甘化陽，合白芍酸甘化陰
composition.role_reason_en: Harmonizes all herbs; combines with Gui Zhi for acrid-sweet yang, combines with Bai Shao for sour-sweet yin

key_pairs_note_zh: 桂枝配白芍 (1:1) 為調和營衛之祖劑（桂枝發衛陽，白芍斂營陰，一開一合）。生薑配大棗調和脾胃氣血。桂枝配甘草辛甘化陽。
key_pairs_note_en: Gui Zhi with Bai Shao (1:1 ratio) is the ancestor pair for harmonizing Ying and Wei (Gui Zhi opens Wei yang, Bai Shao restrains Ying yin). Sheng Jiang with Da Zao harmonizes Spleen and Stomach.
fang_yi_zh: 本方為調和營衛、解肌發表之祖方。桂枝辛溫解肌發表為君；白芍酸寒和營斂陰為臣；桂芍等量配伍，一散一收、一開一合，使表邪去而營衛和；生薑辛溫助桂枝解表，大棗甘溫助白芍和營，共為佐；炙甘草調和諸藥為使，合桂枝辛甘化陽，合白芍酸甘化陰。五味配伍精當，發汗而不傷陰，斂陰而不留邪。
fang_yi_en: Ancestor formula for harmonizing Ying and Wei and releasing the muscle layer. Gui Zhi releases the muscle layer as chief; Bai Shao restrains yin as deputy. Equal amounts of Gui Zhi and Bai Shao balance dispersal and astringence, clearing exterior pathogens while harmonizing Ying and Wei.

indications.pattern_zh: 外感風寒表虛證（太陽中風）
indications.pattern_en: Wind-Cold exterior deficiency (Tai Yang Wind Strike)
indications.clinical_picture_zh: 頭痛、發熱、惡風、汗出、鼻鳴乾嘔、苔薄白、脈浮緩
indications.clinical_picture_en: Headache, fever, aversion to wind, sweating, nasal congestion, dry retching

constitutional_note_zh: 表實無汗脈緊者（麻黃湯證）或濕熱內盛者禁用。

modifications.change_zh: 加厚朴、杏仁——即桂枝加厚朴杏子湯
modifications.change_en: Add Hou Po and Xing Ren (forms Gui Zhi Jia Hou Po Xing Zi Tang)

modifications.if_en: With stiff neck and upper back
modifications.change_zh: 加葛根——即桂枝加葛根湯
modifications.change_en: Add Ge Gen (forms Gui Zhi Jia Ge Gen Tang)

modifications.if_en: With severe sweating in weak patients
modifications.change_en: Add Huang Qi and Bai Zhu

dose_adjustment_note_zh: 服後啜熱稀粥一升以助藥力，溫覆取微似汗，不可令大汗淋漓。
dose_adjustment_note_en: Drink warm thin rice porridge after taking to assist formula strength; cover warmly for slight sweating.
contraindications_zh: 表實無汗者禁用（誤用致表邪難解）
溫病初起、熱病汗出者禁用
contraindications_en: Contraindicated in exterior excess without sweating
Contraindicated in heavy drinkers with damp-heat

comparisons.differentiator_zh: 麻黃湯治表實無汗、脈浮緊；桂枝湯治表虛有汗、惡風、脈浮緩。
comparisons.differentiator_en: Ma Huang Tang treats exterior excess without sweating; Gui Zhi Tang treats exterior deficiency WITH sweating.

formula_song:
桂枝湯用主太陽，芍藥甘草薑棗當。
解肌發表調營衛，中風自汗正宜嘗。
exam_pearl: 【考綱重點】太陽中風表虛證首選方。桂枝配白芍 1:1 調和營衛；生薑大衛調和脾胃。服後需啜熱稀粥助藥力。NCBAHM 2026 CH Outline p.19。
